scope: Offline camera, Codec2 and memory-policy dependency review.

retained_services.name: vendor.honor.hardware.camera.dme
retained_services.startup: disabled/oneshot; not an unconditional boot service

framework_integration: Lineage camera service discovers the retained standard provider through VINTF.
Existing stock ro.vendor.qti.va_aosp.support=1 avoids provider truncation needed by the secure face path.
CameraServiceCapacity and MaxPerformance match upstream task-profile definitions; no duplicate scheduler service added.
Existing DevicePowerService camera-open observer releases its own frequency limits while camera is open.

native_evidence.behavior: Setter forwards string factors to ATMsEventMgr under a mutex; the examined getter returns a default result instead of querying that manager. It is not a trustworthy state-confirmation API.
native_evidence.dependent_inventory: Direct native dependency scan found the interface in the retained camera server and ATMs implementation. No framework-side native client was identified in the examined extracted directories; active stock factor producers remain unverified.

native_evidence.behavior: Camera utility reads kernel memory information; that does not replace Honor framework preallocation or reclaim policy.

remaining_gaps.reason: Stock and prior Lineage provider observations lack the mandatory extensionType advertisement. The stock adapter also depends on private framework/native interfaces; do not synthesize capabilities.

remaining_gaps.feature: Honor camera preallocation, preread and scan policy
remaining_gaps.reason: Stock DataAppHandle calls DmeServer, PostCamera and iAware policy. Standard provider operation does not prove these private features are reproduced.
The receiver is traced; forwarding arbitrary framework events without verified factor keys and lifecycle would be speculative.

native_evidence.behavior: Store selects matched libcodec2_mtk_vdec.so/libcodec2_mtk_venc.so factories using dlopen/dlsym, creates interfaces and queries their traits. XML alone does not instantiate or validate a codec.

codecs.configuration_warning: Legacy vendor media_codecs.xml includes media_codecs_mediatek_audio.xml and media_codecs_google_audio.xml, absent from this extracted vendor directory. The active Codec2 XML is parsed separately. This inherited warning is not proof of lost hardware codecs; no replacement capabilities are manufactured.
remaining_validation: Per-codec functional encode/decode, timestamp and audio synchronization checks on the combined image
Secure codecs require DRM/TEE-compatible content and cannot be qualified by an ordinary clear-content test
Stock application-only quality and high-speed policies must not be inferred from registration alone

stock_protocol.compatibility: These Honor commands are not present in upstream LMKD; no command sender is added.

commands.102: free-kill enable, interval and six thresholds
commands.104: mark big-memory scene if native support enabled
commands.105: bounded native list update (semantics not fully resolved)

retained: Vendor zRAM lz4, 100% RAM swap size and 512M writeback backing-device configuration
Vendor page-cluster=0, swappiness=100 and multi-generation LRU init settings
Existing PSI, kill timeout and thrashing settings

fix.reason: 1001 exceeds OOM_SCORE_ADJ_MAX and disables upstream cached-app low-watermark reclaim. Restore the upstream default when Honor framework reclaim policy is absent.
fix.precedence: Product build properties load after vendor in init.PropertyLoadBootDefaults.
fix.scope: Restores one upstream reclaim path, not the complete Honor policy.

remaining_validation: Camera/video allocation and continuity while under memory pressure
Existing device_config LMKD experiments can override ro.lmk settings; inspect effective values during the next device test

validation.memory_policy: Compiled upstream condition and macros: four cases passed, product assignment and init load order checked.

limits: Offline evidence does not establish complete stock parity or measured performance gains.
Retain matched vendor HALs, tuning, firmware, SELinux and kernel modules.
Do not import stock libCameraHwExtend.so into Lineage cameraserver: it depends on Honor private ABI.
